about: The trading-hours deploy fence (plans deploy-fence-replacement section 6). A fenced tier (unknown tiers are an error, never a default) may change only outside every [open - pad_before, close + pad_after) window of an XNYS session and outside its blackouts, with at least `need` minutes left before the next window. Holidays and half-day afternoons are open (operator call 1, approved 2026-10-24). A policy change is a version bump with a PR.

superset.about: No session table at all (db, cache and bundled all blind): Mon-Fri, holiday-unaware. It contains every real window, so blindness can only refuse more, never ship into a session.

service.why: its roll restarts price-streamer; a tape gap cannot be measured away (operator decision 2026-10-21, trade-infra docs/RTH-FENCE-EXPOSURE.md section 6)

quant.why: OPEN in the session (operator decision 2026-10-21): flips quant-service's own pair; deploy-bluegreen gates the consumer roll on SERVICE=service (edge-host lib-deploy.sh deploy_tier_rth_open)

ui.why: OPEN in the session (operator decision 2026-10-21): swaps a static build and recreates no container

grounder.why: a 3 GB build; never part of the 2026-10-21 decision (edge-host ship-grounder.sh)

adhoc.why: an arbitrary command on the box: edge-host rth-guard's job wrapper, mcp EdgeExec / EdgeService / EdgeMode

observer.why: mcp observer-reconcile.py in_rth fences it today: a restart blinds the outside watcher mid-session

pve.why: the observer VM's parent; anything that restarts it blinds the observer

llmbox.why: the copilot reads it during the session; its daily 04:00 stack-pull is outside every window anyway
